children: Wesdome may repurchase up to 7,187,337 shares, approximately 5% of public float, from Nov. 9, 2026, to Nov. 8, 2027. The prior bid authorized 9,013,300 shares; 7,833,800 had been purchased as of Nov. 4, 2026.
New bid: up to 7,187,337 shares, ~5% of float
Sets the maximum potential share reduction, but purchases are discretionary and the company is not obligated to buy shares.
The new authorization is smaller than the prior cap; actual purchases under it were below that cap.
Shows the scale and average price of repurchases under the expiring bid; no new spending commitment was disclosed.
Defines the window for potential purchases, which remain subject to market conditions and available cash.

This renews the company's existing annual share repurchase program, which expires on Nov. 6, 2026. Actual purchases under the new bid would determine whether it becomes a meaningful capital-return catalyst.
